cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.21)
# This module can be built in the editor tree OR in an independent project.
if(CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR STREQUAL CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR)
    project(SimpleModule LANGUAGES CXX)
    include(GNUInstallDirs)
endif()
if(EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/include/dodev/sdk/dodev_plugin_api.h")
    set(default_sdk "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/include")
else()
    set(default_sdk "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../../include")
endif()
set(DODEV_SDK_INCLUDE "${default_sdk}" CACHE PATH "Directory containing dodev/sdk/dodev_plugin_api.h")
if(NOT EXISTS "${DODEV_SDK_INCLUDE}/dodev/sdk/dodev_plugin_api.h")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Set DODEV_SDK_INCLUDE to the DoDevEditor SDK include directory")
endif()
add_library(simplemodule_plugin MODULE SimpleModule.cpp)
target_compile_features(simplemodule_plugin PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
target_include_directories(simplemodule_plugin PRIVATE "${DODEV_SDK_INCLUDE}")
if(WIN32)
    set_target_properties(simplemodule_plugin PROPERTIES PREFIX "")
elseif(APPLE)
    set_target_properties(simplemodule_plugin PROPERTIES PREFIX "lib" SUFFIX ".dylib")
endif()
# Keep the manifest next to the module so the normal plugin loader finds it.
set(output "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/plugins/simple-module")
set_target_properties(simplemodule_plugin PROPERTIES LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${output}" RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${output}")
foreach(config IN LISTS CMAKE_CONFIGURATION_TYPES)
    string(TOUPPER "${config}" upper)
    set_target_properties(simplemodule_plugin PROPERTIES LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_${upper} "${output}" RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_${upper} "${output}")
endforeach()
configure_file(plugin.json "${output}/plugin.json" COPYONLY)
install(TARGETS simplemodule_plugin LIBRARY DESTINATION "${CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR}/plugins/simple-module" RUNTIME DESTINATION "${CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR}/plugins/simple-module")
install(FILES plugin.json DESTINATION "${CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR}/plugins/simple-module")
